summary: United Microelectronics Corporation (UMC) filed a Form 6-K on September 4, 2026, announcing upcoming investor conference attendance on September 10 and September 14-15, 2026, plus August 2026 monthly revenue figures. August net sales were NT$25.04 billion, up 30.71% year-over-year; year-to-date sales rose 14.66%. No special-situation transaction or corporate action is described. This is a routine operational update and investor-relations disclosure by a foreign private issuer. No deal terms or special-situations characteristics apply, so this filing does not qualify for a special-situations category.
